tools.name: sts_game_status
tools.title: Downfall process and connection status
tools.description: Inspect test-game process/connection without launching or playing.

tools.name: sts_start_game
tools.title: Start Downfall and connect
tools.description: Start/reuse the verified test game only on a user launch/play request. Never resumes a run or chooses actions. If starting, inspect status; do not relaunch.

tools.name: sts_get_state
tools.title: Current game decision
tools.description: Current decision + toc of state-scoped fragments. Read needed refs with sts_get_context before acting; details_required or incomplete means do not guess. Send known_view from the previous response for a short unchanged reply; omit it to recover the summary.

tools.name: sts_act
tools.title: Act and await next game decision
tools.description: ONE offered action with current session/state IDs. Read needed details first; never auto-discard. Unknown/applied_waiting: inspect state/request, never replay. Returns receipt and next decision.

tools.name: sts_get_context
tools.title: Additional public game context
tools.description: Read 1-8 toc refs using the SAME session/state IDs. Returns short fields, child toc, or exact text chunks. Follow next_offset (row/field index; UTF-16 offset for text). No full dump. Stale: refresh state and rediscover refs. Read relevant rules fragments.

tools.name: sts_get_request
tools.title: Inspect action outcome without replay
tools.description: Inspect a recent action receipt by request_id without replay. Missing is unknown, not failure; never resend.

rules.act: Use only offered actions from a ready state. Read referenced details needed for the decision. One action per call; never replay unknown/applied_waiting outcomes. Refresh state after stale rejection.
rules.upgrade: Before acquisition or upgrade, read the offered card upgrade_preview and relevant keyword details. It is only the next standard upgrade, not random/event/relic outcomes. Read selected_after before separate branch/tree confirmation.
rules.event: Read and present the current event body, situation and choices before acknowledgement. Supply the observed reading_id and meaningful commentary; discuss result pages too. Do not silently acknowledge incomplete text.
rules.map: Map planning draws a route, never moves the character. Use offered map_id/revision and node IDs; stale revisions are rejected. Native edges only, not predicted travel powers.
rules.reward: Read reward_navigation before leaving: unclaimed rewards may be abandoned. Never auto-discard a potion to make space; discarding is a separate destructive choice.
rules.cost: Use native displayed_cost_text and cost_components (energy/reserves/X/Pyre). Incomplete or unrendered costs are unknown. Read target_playability and unplayable_reason before playing.

next_step: sts_get_state or sts_game_status; do not start a second game
